parsed.production_notes: The video uses a split-screen format where the top panel features a photorealistic but clearly AI-generated female humanoid robot, while the bottom panel is a standard human-recorded video of a woman.
parsed.interaction_pattern: AI tutor quizzes a learner, who answers incorrectly; the tutor then provides a live correction of the spontaneous wrong-English mistake and explains the rule.
parsed.audio_track: Spoken dialogue in Tamil and English between two characters. There is no background music.

characters.appearance: A female-presenting humanoid robot with a sleek, metallic body made of white and silver components. She has a defined, human-like facial structure with bright blue, luminous eyes and no hair. Her build is slender and futuristic.
characters.wardrobe: As a robot, she wears no clothes. Her body is her 'wardrobe'. She has black in-ear headphones connected by a thin black wire that hangs down her chest.
characters.demeanor: Calm, knowledgeable, and persuasive. Her facial expressions are subtle but she appears patient and encouraging.

characters.appearance: A young South Indian woman in her early to mid-20s with a medium complexion. She has large, expressive dark brown eyes, and her shoulder-length, wavy black hair is parted to the side. She has a friendly and relatable appearance.
characters.wardrobe: A light-colored, possibly off-white or beige, three-quarter sleeve kurta with a traditional blue and brown block print pattern.
characters.demeanor: Her demeanor shifts throughout the ad: initially uncertain and making mistakes, then showing understanding, concern about cost, and finally becoming excited and convinced by the tutor's pitch.

scenes.setting: The AI tutor is in a warmly lit, traditionally decorated Indian living room. The human learner is against a plain, off-white wall in a brightly lit space.
scenes.camera: Medium close-up on both characters in their respective panels.

panels.panel_visual_description: A medium close-up of Character A, a female humanoid robot, sitting at a wooden table in a cozy, traditionally decorated Indian room. The room has warm lighting, with shelves holding brass items and framed pictures on the wall behind her. She looks directly forward, speaking, with subtle movements of her head and mouth.

A medium close-up of Character B, a young woman, standing against a plain, off-white wall. She looks directly at the camera. Her expression changes from neutral with closed eyes, to speaking, to listening intently, and finally to a small smile of understanding.

scenes.visual_description: A vertically split-screen video. The top panel shows the AI tutor (Character A) and the bottom panel shows the human learner (Character B). As Character B gives an incorrect answer, a red 'X' graphic appears over Character A's chest. When Character A provides the correction, a white checkmark graphic appears instead. Text bubbles with the dialogue appear between the two panels.
scenes.audio_transcript:
Character A says: உனக்கு எத்தனை brothers இருக்காங்க? [How many brothers do you have?]
Character B says: I am having two brothers.
Character A says: Having-னு சொல்லக்கூடாது. [You shouldn't say 'having'.]
Character A says: நீ ரெண்டு பேரையும் கைல புடிச்சிட்டு இருக்கியா என்ன? [Are you holding both of them in your hands or what?]
Character A says: 'I have two brothers'-னு தான் சொல்லணும். ['I have two brothers' is what you should say.]
